key_insight: MolHIT introduces a hierarchical discrete diffusion framework for molecular graphs that closes the performance gap between graph-based and 1D molecular generative models, substantially improving chemical validity and property fidelity. It generates molecules in a coarse-to-fine, chemically-aware manner to better respect discrete chemistry constraints.
problem_solved: Existing graph diffusion models produce many invalid molecules and struggle to match target properties, limiting their usefulness for drug discovery and materials design; MolHIT addresses these shortcomings by combining multi-scale graph representation with discrete, chemistry-aware diffusion dynamics.
method: Hierarchical representation: generate molecular graphs across multiple scales (coarse structure → fine atom/bond details) using a coarse-to-fine diffusion pipeline.
Discrete diffusion on graph tokens: perform diffusion steps in a discrete atom/bond vocabulary with chemistry constraints (e.g., valence-aware transitions) to maintain validity during sampling.
Conditioning & sampling strategy: joint property-conditioning and specialized denoising/sampling routines to better match target molecular properties while preserving structural chemistry.
impact: MolHIT makes graph-based molecular generation more reliable and competitive with 1D approaches, enabling practitioners to produce higher-quality candidate molecules for downstream property optimization and experimental validation. It reduces the gap between graph expressiveness and chemical validity, accelerating AI-driven discovery workflows.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: coarse-to-fine hierarchical diffusion flow from scaffold to full molecule (graph nodes/edges) with labelled stages.
Bar/line chart: comparison of chemical validity, uniqueness, and property-matching metrics vs. baseline graph and 1D models.
Schematic of discrete diffusion: timestep illustration showing token corruption and valence-aware denoising on atoms/bonds.
Icon set: molecule, graph, diffusion clock, target property gauge (to represent conditioning/optimization).
paper_title: MolHIT: Advancing Molecular-Graph Generation with Hierarchical Discrete Diffusion Models
paper_authors: Hojung Jung, Rodrigo Hormazabal, Jaehyeong Jo, Youngrok Park, Kyunggeun Roh
